text: In response to concerns raised by residents regarding limited parking availability on Dentonia Park Avenue, my office has received a petition from community members requesting changes to the current parking regulations. Specifically, residents are asking that parking on the north side of Dentonia Park Avenue, between Avonlea Boulevard and Sibley Avenue, be limited to a maximum of one hour. On-street permit parking holders would remain exempt from the one-hour limit.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized parking for a maximum period of one hour from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Dentonia Park Avenue, between Avonlea Boulevard and Sibley Avenue.
